sources.label: web search for conventions coming to Nashville and who works them
sources.instruction: Only events whose dates fall between today and 9 months from today. For each item give: the event name, the dates, the host venue, expected attendance if the page states it, the organizer, and the link. For companies, give the company name, what it does for the event, and the link to its own public website or contact page. Never give a person's email or phone unless it is printed on a public business page you found, and then give that page's link.
queries: conventions, trade shows and association conferences booked at Music City Center in Nashville in the next 9 months, with dates and expected attendance
large conferences and corporate meetings at Gaylord Opryland Resort and Convention Center and downtown Nashville hotels in the next 9 months
Nashville destination management companies (DMCs) and corporate meeting planners that run offsite events, receptions and dinners for conventions
official general service contractors, event production and decor companies working Nashville conventions this year
meeting planners or associations that have announced Nashville as the host city for an upcoming conference, and their event or partnership contacts

does: Every Monday, finds the conventions, trade shows and big corporate meetings coming to Nashville in the next 9 months, with dates, host venue, size and organizer
Finds the companies that work them and hire out the extras: destination management companies, meeting planners, production and decor contractors
Drafts a short, specific email to each one offering our venues, catering, bar and lighting for their receptions, dinners and offsite nights
Every item carries the link it came from

traits.instead: Drafts it; a person on our team sends it

traits.cant: Look up a person's private email or phone
traits.instead: Uses only contact details printed on a company's own public page, with the link

traits.cant: Read event calendars behind a login
traits.instead: Reads public pages only; anything it could not confirm is marked (unverified)
